tensor_alchemist.title: MiniMax H3 Ref2VA Inpainting - User-Friendly v10 - Prompt Only
tensor_alchemist.status: EXECUTION TESTED: prompt-only graph with measured 19-frame source-anchor removal; 192-frame joint AV output verified
tensor_alchemist.native_generation_limit: 4-15 seconds at 24 fps; longer output requires sequential continuation, which is not execution-certified in this workflow
tensor_alchemist.resolution_disclosure: The crop targets -0.18 MP and may round upward; Subject Uncrop restores the source canvas, but regenerated pixels are not native 2K/4K and encoded output is not claimed pixel-exact outside the mask.
tensor_alchemist.prompt_contract_status: EXECUTION-SUPPORTED ON ONE COBALT-HAIR TEST; not universal
tensor_alchemist.execution_evidence: Strong prompt arm: 107x448x448, 20 steps, 307.456 seconds, observed 7185 MiB VRAM peak, exact source audio retained; blue>=0.25 improved 20/91 to 73/91 versus the older prompt.
tensor_alchemist.composite_mask_evidence: Cache-only downstream test: processed node 23 output 0 feeds node 24; 6.53 seconds; blue>=0.25 reached 76 frames and frame 80 was restored.
tensor_alchemist.mask_coverage_boundary: Test tracker produced 16 zero-mask frames; frame 0 and final four frames remained unresolved due absent H3 mask coverage or opening-anchor lock.
tensor_alchemist.035mp_memory_smoke: PASS for one-step memory/decode only: prompt 51c46bc8-5d7e-4e13-a8aa-61a86aeab658; no cached nodes; actual 107x608x608; 167.685 seconds Comfy execution / 168.403 seconds monitor; observed 7176 MiB peak; 107-frame 1296x720/24 fps output; exact decoded audio; quality NOT tested.
tensor_alchemist.ui_load_evidence: PASS in live Chrome/ComfyUI: correct v2.1 title/id, all graph nodes instantiated, both Run controls enabled, queue untouched. Manager showed two dependency-index warning groups for eight live local nodes and the installed/executed SAM checkpoint; these are not backend contract failures.
uncertified_features: -0.35 MP 20-step quality and headroom on this 8GB target

dependency_provenance.metadata_policy: CNR installer pins were removed from locally present Git/hardened nodes because the live Manager inspector misclassified them as missing. Exact source provenance is retained here and in the intel bank.

tensor_alchemist.presentation_change: Removed all six Markdown notes, the bypassed SOL node, and the disconnected bypassed continuation helper. Replaced long repeated typed links with current KJNodes Set/Get virtual routing, compacted sizes, collapsed fixed infrastructure, and applied factual node and group titles. All generation widgets and effective execution connections are unchanged from the v2.2 parent after normal bypass resolution; only the SaveVideo filename prefix was neutralized for public use.

virtual_routing.contract: one uniquely named Set per root graph; any number of same-name typed Gets; no physical Set-to-Get link

tensor_alchemist.presentation_evidence_boundary: This derived file inherits the recorded v2.1 execution evidence only because the builder proves effective edge and backend-node semantic equivalence. Exact v3 UI load and virtual-resolution checks are recorded in the external validation report; no new denoise was queued for this presentation-only refactor.
tensor_alchemist.manual_reference_placeholder: Node 22 is a collapsed LoadImage placeholder and is intentionally disconnected so it cannot alter the tested baseline. If used, add the intended Ref2VA image input and matching Picture/Subject labels manually.
tensor_alchemist.prompt_contract_disclosure: The retained execution-tested prompt uses the custom phrase fully_preserved_except_user_edit. It is not one of the stock official retention markers; changing it requires a separate prompt A/B and was intentionally excluded from this presentation-only refactor.
tensor_alchemist.car_tracking_evidence: SAM3 text prompt 'blue rally car' produced 88 nonzero masks across 90 frames; frames 73-74 were fully dust-occluded and were bridged by the existing temporal mask logic.
tensor_alchemist.car_replacement_evidence: PASS: matte-crimson rally buggy replacement is visible and temporally coherent after the opening anchor; dust occlusion is preserved; result is 90 frames at 24 fps with AAC stereo 32 kHz source audio.
tensor_alchemist.car_replacement_caveat: Frame 0 remains strongly anchored to the blue source car; the appearance transition occurs over the opening frames. The 243-frame source contains a hard cut and must be handled as separate shot windows rather than one tracking/inpaint pass.
tensor_alchemist.friendly_preview_change: Removed the display-only black-and-white tiled MaskPreview, collapsed the three advanced automatic mask processors, and added one synchronized frame control with a cyan raw-tracking overlay and a magenta overlay for the feathered pixels actually blended back into the source video. The internal H3 latent-grid safety mask remains collapsed. The SaveVideo generation path and all v3.1 generation widgets remain unchanged.

friendly_preview_colors.cyan: SAM3 tracked object before H3 alignment
friendly_preview_colors.magenta: final feathered compositing region blended back into the source video

tensor_alchemist.upgrade_output_name: MiniMax H3 Ref2VA Inpainting - User-Friendly v4.json
upgrade_changes: Added official SAM3 Track Preview with color-coded object IDs.
Expanded SAM3 Track to Mask so object_indices is directly editable.
Routed source FPS through the existing KJ Set/Get bus into the preview.
Moved the exact saved Ref2VA prompt into MiniMaxH3XPromptLint without rewriting it.
Added visible Prompt Check Results using the core PreviewAny node.
Removed the remaining Markdown instruction note only.
Cleared stale absolute output-preview metadata while preserving save settings.

sam3_preview_provenance.contract: Produces a temporary color-overlay video with numeric object IDs; it does not alter the selected mask or H3 generation path.

prompt_lint_evidence.rewrite_policy: passes prompt through unchanged; no LLM

tensor_alchemist.generation_path_boundary: The source model, source media, SAM tracking, crop, H3-aligned latent mask, masked AV latent, sampler, decoder, composite, and save settings are preserved. The only inline addition is a deterministic pass-through prompt linter using the identical prompt bytes.
tensor_alchemist.current_reference_state: No image, video, or audio reference is connected or declared. Edit the tracking text and the plain-language replacement prompt only.
rejected_as_general_replacements: T8 multi-person face and selective-repair nodes are experimental and not a general object-mask replacement.
PainterNodes was rejected locally because of exact node-ID collisions.
The third-party H3 AttentionMask pack remains blocked by license and mask-contract findings.
tensor_alchemist.user_confirmed_8s_ceiling: 1216 x 672 at 24 fps on this 8 GB laptop GPU
tensor_alchemist.prompt_only_evidence: 124-frame bounded run completed with zero node errors and five inspected frames all showing full excavator-to-elephant replacement without any reference media.
tensor_alchemist.removed_static_reference: Removed node 22, link 90, every optional reference socket on node 25, Picture 1 wording, and ref_images=1. Bypassing is no longer required or supported.
tensor_alchemist.measured_opening_anchor: Retained 192-frame run showed source excavator through frame 18 and the first fully clean elephant at frame 19. Frames 0-18 are replaced by clean frame 19, then frames 19-end continue unchanged. This preserves 192 frames and audio, with a 0.792-second held opening.
tensor_alchemist.rejected_repairs: Forcing mask coverage into frame 0 did not defeat the model anchor. Replacing only frame 0 failed because frame 1 was also anchored. Neither rejected branch is present here.
tensor_alchemist.final_av_evidence: 8.00 seconds; 192 frames; 1216x672; 24 fps; H.264 yuv420p; AAC stereo 32000 Hz. Frames 0,18,19,48,96,144,191 visually inspected: elephant present, excavator absent.
